messages:
tess (AE): Quick sync - FinServe wants a 3-week pilot. Core asks: vector search + embeddings, rerank, and tool-calls for account enrichment. Must support 32k context for large contracts. They need EU data residency and an initial price estimate. Target kickoff Mon 4/17. Any major blockers?

omar (SE): Noted. A few clarifying Qs: average doc size? expected peak QPS? Do they have labeled queries for evals or do we need to create them?

tess (AE): Docs ~60k, avg ~900 tokens, some long contracts up to 25k tokens. Peak demo traffic ~150 QPS. They can provide ~200 labeled queries but want us to expand to ~400 for solid stats.

jia (SRE): For 150 QPS with p95 < 600ms on combined search+rerank path we should propose Dedicated. Recommend caching for hot prefixes and a small cross-encoder reranker on CPU for speed. Also: plan for continuous batching + q4 quantization to cut costs.

claire (Security): They sent an initial security questionnaire. Key constraints: no PII may leave customer VPC unless tokenized, keys must be in their KMS (HSM ok), and logs need masking. Also confirm EU (eu-west-1) residency for all pilot artifacts.

omar (SE): Tool-call design note: keep sensitive enrichment inside customer infra via function call pattern. Example:
```json
{
  "name": "enrich_account",
  "args": {"account_id": "<id>", "fields": ["owner","risk_score"]}
}
```
We return only non-PII summaries.

jia (SRE): Quick price sketch for 3 weeks (Dedicated, q4 quant):
- Ingest + indexing compute: ~$1.2k
- Serving + Dedicated pool (150 QPS, buffer): ~$6k
- Ops/support + onboarding: $1.0k
Estimated total: ~$8.2k. If they require Private (customer infra) remove serving fee and add integration estimate (~$3k).

tess (AE): Thanks. Can you add a best-effort SLA note for latency and an A/B canary plan? I'll include pricing in proposal.

jia (SRE): Will add: canary rollout (10% traffic -> 50% -> 100%), fallback to smaller gen model on overload, and automated routing by latency. SLA: p95 < 700ms guaranteed on Dedicated during pilot, p95 < 900ms on Private (infra dependent).

claire (Security): On SCCQ: I'll prepare answers and ask them for a contact for key provisioning. We can support customer-managed KMS if legal signs addendum. Also need their data retention window for logs.

omar (SE): For model selection: propose embeddings model redwood-embed-32k, gen model redwood-gen-32k-q4 for synthesis/tool-calls, and cpu cross-encoder (open model) for rerank. We should run a small eval comparing 16k vs 32k context for their long-contract cases.

tess (AE): Acceptance criteria to get to pilot success (customer agrees):
- Retrieval QA F1 >= 0.8 on golden set
- Rerank MRR lift >= 10% vs their baseline
- End-to-end p95 search+rerank < 700ms (Dedicated)
- Tool-call responses within 400ms when hitting internal API
- Security: SCCQ signed + KMS provisioning confirmed

jia (SRE): I'll prototype the eval harness and generate additional labeled queries from their 200 seeds using augmentation. ETA for harness + initial run: 5 business days.

claire (Security): I'll draft SCCQ answers and KMS steps by Wed. Need contact and a high-level network diagram from the customer.

tess (AE): Action items:
- omar: provide implementation/SDK notes and prompt templates (due Wed)
- jia: cost note + eval harness + canary plan (due Fri)
- claire: SCCQ responses + KMS checklist (due Wed)
- tess: send proposal + schedule kickoff Mon 4/17

calendar-bot: Meeting created: FinServe Pilot Kickoff Mon 4/17 10:00am UTC. Invite sent to team. :calendar:
